title: Pentaryn Senses
description: Lights, glow and chains for dnd5e 6. Token vision from the sheet's senses is dnd5e's own now (senseVisionSync); this module only resets, once per world, the darkvision sight its retired 0.3 sync stored on tokens, so a removed sense really goes dark (setting pentaryn-senses.sightReset, active GM, on ready). Lights carried by items (flags.pentaryn-senses.light) light whoever carries them and go dark when the item leaves. Torches, lamps, lanterns and candles get a Light/Douse button on the inventory row (flags.pentaryn-senses.lit), hooded lanterns a hood. The Light cantrip lights a token or a square instead of summoning a floor token ("On me" / "Pick a target" on cast, and On me / Pick a target / End as icons in the spell card's action row); Produce Flame's Cast lights its caster with a flame, no prompt. A second activity-choice dialog for the same light item (a double-click) closes. Adds the "Broken glow (wandering)" light animation (pentaryn-brokenglow), whose size and brightness ride a wave that never repeats, and token chains drawn between two tokens. Writes run on the active GM's client only. Exposes game.pentaryn.senses.

recommends.reason: Light's Pick a target closes open Combat HUD panels first (argon.mjs)

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), then reload.
Already enabled? A browser RELOAD (F5) picks up new .mjs files and assets.
Token vision is dnd5e's senseVisionSync (6.0+); the one-shot reset of stored
darkvision runs at GM ready — check game.settings.get('pentaryn-senses', 'sightReset') === 1
Token chains: game.pentaryn.chain.links() · Token HUD → Break chain.
